meta.project: Sistem Informasi Manajemen & Portal Publik Masjid Al-Falah

product_overview: Sistem ini menyediakan portal publik interaktif untuk jemaah dan masyarakat, sekaligus dashboard terpusat bagi pengurus DKM untuk mengelola keuangan, program kerja, jemaah, qurban, berita, inventaris, jadwal, dan pengaturan sistem. Aplikasi menekankan transparansi, kemudahan operasional, dan keterhubungan langsung antara layanan publik dan administrasi masjid.
core_goals: Menyediakan portal publik yang menampilkan informasi masjid, jadwal sholat, transparansi keuangan, berita, dan kontak jemaah.
Memungkinkan masyarakat mendaftar sebagai jemaah dan mengirim pertanyaan atau pesan kepada DKM.
Memberi pengurus DKM akses terpusat untuk mengelola keuangan, program kerja, jemaah, qurban, ZISWAF, inventaris, jadwal petugas, dan berita.
Mendukung transparansi dan akuntabilitas pengelolaan masjid melalui laporan, ringkasan kas, dan publikasi informasi terbuka.
Menyediakan pengaturan sistem dan manajemen pengguna berbasis peran untuk operasional DKM.

features.name: Public Landing Page & Interactive Overview
features.description: Halaman beranda publik yang menampilkan ringkasan masjid, jadwal sholat, transparansi kas, peta jemaah, berita terkini, donasi, pendaftaran jemaah, dan kontak publik.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View prayer times and countdown -> Review financial snapshot -> Open donation information -> Inspect the jemaah map -> Submit jemaah registration form -> Submit contact inquiry form

features.name: Public Financial Transparency
features.description: Halaman publik untuk melihat saldo kas terbuka, ringkasan pemasukan dan pengeluaran, rincian kategori dana, dan rekening resmi masjid.
user_flows: Navigate to /transparansi-keuangan -> Review total cash reserves -> Inspect income and expense summaries -> Explore category breakdown charts -> View official bank account details

features.name: Public Mosque Profile
features.description: Halaman profil publik yang memuat sejarah masjid, visi misi, struktur organisasi, fasilitas, dan galeri.
user_flows: Navigate to /profil -> Read mosque history -> Review vision and mission -> Inspect organization structure -> Browse facilities and photo gallery

features.name: Public News & Activities Portal
features.description: Portal berita publik untuk mencari artikel, memfilter berdasarkan kategori, dan membaca detail berita dalam modal.
user_flows: Navigate to /berita-kegiatan -> Search for an article by keyword -> Filter news by category -> Open an article for reading -> Review reading time and publication date

features.name: DKM Staff Authentication
features.description: Gerbang login khusus pengurus DKM untuk masuk ke dashboard administrasi.
user_flows: Navigate to /portal-dkm -> Enter staff email address -> Enter staff password -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /portal-dkm -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See validation error

features.name: Executive Dashboard Overview
features.description: Halaman ringkasan utama untuk pengurus yang menampilkan metrik penting, grafik arus kas, jadwal sholat hari ini, dan navigasi cepat ke modul lain.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View cash balance and jemaah metrics -> Inspect cash flow charts -> Review today's prayer schedule -> Use quick navigation to access another module

features.name: Financial Cash Flow Management
features.description: Modul pengelolaan transaksi kas untuk mencatat pemasukan dan pengeluaran, memfilter data, mengubah data transaksi, dan mengekspor laporan.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Add a new income transaction -> Add a new expense transaction -> Filter transactions by date, category, or type -> Edit an existing transaction -> Delete an existing transaction -> Export the report to PDF or Excel
Navigate to /dashboard/keuangan -> Enter a transaction with missing or incomplete required information -> Submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: Work Program & Kanban Management
features.description: Modul pengelolaan program kerja dengan papan Kanban, pencatatan anggaran, dan sinkronisasi otomatis ke ledger keuangan saat program selesai.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Create a new work program with budget and PIC -> Move the program card across Kanban columns -> Mark the program as completed -> Enter budget realization details -> See the related financial record created
Navigate to /dashboard/program-kerja -> Create a program with invalid or incomplete required details -> Submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: Jemaah Database & GIS Mapping
features.description: Database jemaah untuk menambah, mengubah, menyaring, memetakan, mengimpor, dan mengekspor data warga serta lokasi geotagged mereka.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Add a new jemaah record -> Edit an existing jemaah record -> Filter jemaah by category -> View geotagged locations on the map -> Export the data to spreadsheet
Navigate to /dashboard/jemaah -> Import a spreadsheet with invalid data format -> Submit the import -> See validation error

features.name: Qurban Grouping & Management
features.description: Modul qurban terpadu untuk mengelola tahun qurban, membentuk kelompok hewan, menambahkan pequrban, dan melacak status pembayaran.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/qurban -> Manage the active qurban year -> Create or organize animal groups -> Assign pequrban to a cow group -> Update payment status -> Review qurban group progress
Navigate to /dashboard/qurban -> Add more than 7 pequrban to one cow group -> Submit the assignment -> See validation error

features.name: ZISWAF Management
features.description: Modul pencatatan dana ZISWAF untuk memasukkan transaksi, memfilter data, dan mencetak atau mengekspor bukti penerimaan.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/ziswaf -> Record a new ZISWAF donation -> Filter entries by category or donor name -> Print or export receipt proof

features.name: Mosque Inventory & Asset Management
features.description: Modul inventaris untuk menambah aset, memperbarui kondisi barang, dan menghapus item yang sudah tidak dipakai.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Add a new asset with location and condition -> Update the asset condition -> Delete an obsolete inventory item
Navigate to /dashboard/inventaris -> Enter an asset with missing required details -> Submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: Duty & Prayer Staff Schedule
features.description: Modul jadwal petugas ibadah untuk menetapkan khotib, imam, dan muadzin, serta memfilter jadwal berdasarkan peran atau tanggal.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/jadwal -> Assign staff for a duty role -> Enter sermon topic and contact details -> Filter the schedule by role or date -> Review the assigned schedule
Navigate to /dashboard/jadwal -> Enter an assignment with invalid or incomplete details -> Submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: News CMS & Publication
features.description: Sistem manajemen berita untuk membuat, mengubah, mempublikasikan, dan menghapus artikel yang tampil di portal publik.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/berita -> Create a news article with title, category, summary, content, and image -> Edit the article -> Unpublish the article -> Delete the article
Navigate to /dashboard/berita -> Create an article with invalid or incomplete required fields -> Submit the form -> See validation error

features.name: Public Contact Inquiries & Direct WhatsApp Reply
features.description: Inbox pesan masuk publik untuk meninjau pertanyaan warga, memperbarui status, dan membuka balasan langsung melalui WhatsApp.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/pesan -> Review incoming messages -> Filter messages by status -> Open the direct WhatsApp reply flow -> Update the message status

features.name: System Settings & User RBAC Management
features.description: Halaman pengaturan untuk mengelola profil masjid, rekening bank, kategori kas, serta akun pengguna dan peran akses.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Update mosque profile information -> Manage bank accounts and cash categories -> Add a new DKM user -> Change the user's role -> Save the settings
Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Enter invalid or incomplete profile or user data -> Submit the form -> See validation error
